lesson-intro.text: You know these fruits already. Now they all share one bowl. Watch who goes in front, then you try.

rim-pear.text: Begin with the bowl's front rim, one long curve. Then the pear: two sides and a stem.

apple.text: The apple leans on the pear. Curve up each side, then a dip at the top and a stem.

leaf.text: A leaf points left from the stem. Go out and back, then a line up its middle.

grapes.text: Grapes fill the right side. Draw five curves, each one tucked in behind.

grape-stem.text: The bunch needs a stem. Go up and over to the right, then close the little gap.

banana.text: A banana lies across the back. From the leaf, go up and over, then cap each end.

banana-lines.text: Fill in the bits of banana between the fruit. Add three long lines, one carrying on past the stem.

bowl.text: Back to the bowl. Draw the rim, the sides and a foot. Add a short curve by the grapes.

blue.text: Color the bowl blue, darker on the inside.

red-green.text: The apple is red and the pear is light green.

yellow-purple.text: Color the banana yellow and the grapes purple.

last-bits.text: Stems and banana ends are brown, the leaves green. Then a soft gray shadow.

lesson-outro.text: A whole bowl of fruit, and you drew every piece. That's the Fruits path, finished.
